penguin.why: Singular is 'Manchot' (correct FR for penguin); plural of manchot is manchots, not the unrelated species pingouins (auks).

muffin-tin.why: 'moule' (récipient/mold) is masculine (le moule); la moule = mussel. Head noun of 'Moule à muffins' is masculine.

mercury.why: The planet/element Mercure is masculine (cf. Mars, Neptune both m in-batch); 'f' is the clear outlier.
